name: Principal + Token authentication model
description: Devin API authentication model. PRINCIPAL is who you are (identity); TOKEN is how you prove it (credential). Two principal types: Service User (non-human) and User (human). Two corresponding token types: Service User API Key and Personal Access Token (PAT). Both share the `cog_` prefix and the same Authorization header format.

name: Service User (non-human principal)
description: Non-human principal designed for API integrations and CI/CD. RBAC role-controlled. Created via Settings > Service users (org) or Enterprise settings > Service users. Recommended over PATs for production automation.

name: Personal Access Token (PAT)
description: Token authenticating as the human user who created it — user's identity, permissions, and org memberships apply. Currently in CLOSED BETA, feature-flagged. NOT available for SSO/enterprise accounts. `cog_` prefix.

name: Service User API Key
description: API key tied to a service user. `cog_` prefix; shown only once at creation time. Used in `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Recommended for automation, CI/CD, production workflows.

name: Legacy Personal API Key
description: Deprecated. Tied to a user account. Prefix `apk_user_`. Used with v1 and v2 APIs. Inherits user permissions; no RBAC. Continues to work during deprecation period; not accepted by Devin MCP server.

name: Legacy Service API Key
description: Deprecated. Organization-scoped service key. Prefix `apk_`. Used with v1 API. No RBAC.

name: API v1 (legacy, deprecated)
description: Legacy v1 API. Base URL `https://api.devin.ai/v1/*`. Org-scoped flat structure. Auth via `apk_user_` / `apk_` keys. No RBAC. Continues working during deprecation period; will be removed.

name: API v2 (legacy enterprise, deprecated)
description: Legacy v2 API. Base URL `https://api.devin.ai/v2/enterprise/*`. Enterprise-Admin-role only. Personal API keys only (no service keys). Continues during deprecation; lacks new features (RBAC, session attribution, cursor pagination).

name: API v3 (current)
description: Current API. Two scopes: Organization (`/v3/organizations/{org_id}/*`) and Enterprise (`/v3/enterprise/*`). Service user tokens (`cog_`). Full RBAC. Cursor-based pagination. Session attribution via `create_as_user_id`. Custom enterprise domains supported.

name: Organization API scope
description: v3 sub-API rooted at `/v3/organizations/{org_id}/*`. Manages resources within a single organization — sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, schedules, service-users, audit-logs, etc. Where most integrations start.

name: Enterprise API scope
description: v3 sub-API rooted at `/v3/enterprise/*`. Cross-organization — analytics, audit logs, user/role/IdP-group management, billing, infrastructure (hypervisors), service-user provisioning, organization CRUD. Available to enterprise customers.

name: `create_as_user_id` (session attribution)
description: Optional parameter on Create Session. When set, the session is attributed to the specified user — appears in their session list, counts toward their usage. Requires the `ImpersonateOrgSessions` permission on the calling service user's role.

name: Custom enterprise API domain
description: Devin Enterprise customers with dedicated deployments replace `api.devin.ai` with their own domain (e.g., `api.your-company.devinenterprise.com`).

name: Cursor-based pagination
description: Pagination model used by all v3 list endpoints. Query params: `first` (page size, integer, default varies), `after` (opaque cursor; omit on first page). Response: items[], has_next_page, end_cursor, optional total. Replaces offset/limit from v1/v2.

name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
description: Permission model in v3. Each endpoint is gated by a specific named permission. Service-user roles aggregate permissions. Two scopes: Enterprise permissions and Organization permissions. Enterprise service users automatically inherit corresponding org-level permissions across all orgs.

name: Enterprise→Organization permission inheritance
description: Enterprise service users assigned an enterprise-level role automatically get the corresponding org-level permission in every organization. Example: ViewAccountSessions grants ViewOrgSessions in all orgs.

name: Session (API resource)
description: The core agent-run resource. Created by POST /v3/organizations/{org_id}/sessions. Has a session_id, URL (https://app.devin.ai/sessions/<id>), status, prompt, optional title/playbook/tags/ACU-limit. Polls via Get Session; receives messages via Send Message.

name: Session status enum
description: Session lifecycle states. v1: running. v3 introduces more granular settled states: exit, error, suspended (and more — full schema on endpoint reference pages). Used by polling code (`while status not in {'exit','error','suspended'}: poll`).

name: Session attachment
description: File produced by a session (logs, screenshots, generated code). Listed via GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/sessions/{session_id}/attachments — returns items[] with attachment_id, name, url. Download from `url` directly.

name: Knowledge note (API resource)
description: Persistent context Devin uses across sessions. Fields: name, trigger (when this knowledge applies), body (the content). Org-level (POST /v3/organizations/{org_id}/knowledge/notes) and Enterprise-level (POST /v3/enterprise/knowledge/notes).

name: Knowledge folder (structure)
description: Hierarchical folder structure containing knowledge notes. Counts of notes per folder retrievable via GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/knowledge/folders.

name: Playbook (API resource)
description: Reusable instruction set Devin can be parameterized with. Fields: name, instructions, optional macro (e.g., `!plan`). Org-level + Enterprise-level. Triggers on assignment, label, comment-mention via integrations.

name: Secret (API resource)
description: Stored credential referenced as `$VARIABLE_NAME` from blueprints and sessions. Org-level only (Devin's secrets dashboard). Endpoints under /v3/organizations/{org_id}/secrets.

name: Schedule (API resource)
description: Recurring or one-time auto-session trigger. Fields: prompt, cron_schedule (cron expression), timezone, is_enabled, optional notification preferences and agent selection. Org-level. Endpoint: /v3/organizations/{org_id}/schedules.

name: IdP group (API resource)
description: Identity-provider group sync. Both enterprise and organization scope. Used for SSO-driven membership management. Endpoints CRUD groups + assign/unassign users.

name: Tag (session tag)
description: User-defined string label attached to sessions. Org-allowed-tags configurable; default-tag settable. Sessions can have tags added/replaced/removed. Used for org-side categorization of agent runs.

name: Guardrail violation (API resource)
description: Tripped-policy event surfaced for compliance review. Both enterprise and org scope. Endpoint: GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/guardrail-violations and GET /v3/enterprise/guardrail-violations.

name: Audit log entry
description: Tamper-evident record of an action. Both enterprise and org scope. v3: GET /v3/enterprise/audit-logs and GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/audit-logs.

name: Consumption cycle
description: Billing cycle summary. Endpoint: GET /v3/enterprise/consumption/cycles. Tracks ACU usage per cycle.

name: Daily consumption breakdown
description: Per-day ACU consumption. Multiple breakdowns: by user, by service-user, by session, by organization. Both enterprise and org scope.

name: Active users metrics (DAU/WAU/MAU/custom-range)
description: Engagement metrics. Endpoints for daily/weekly/monthly active users and a custom-date-range variant. Both enterprise and org scope.

name: PR metrics
description: Pull-request-creation analytics. Both enterprise and org scope. Endpoint: GET /v3/enterprise/metrics/prs and GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/metrics/prs.

name: Session metrics
description: Session-count/category analytics. Both enterprise and org scope. Includes sessions-by-category for richer slicing.

name: Usage metrics
description: Generic usage analytics surface. Enterprise: /v3/enterprise/metrics/usage. Organization: /v3/organizations/{org_id}/metrics/usage and ../usage-org.

name: Search metrics
description: Search-related analytics. Both enterprise and org scope.

name: Queue status
description: Snapshot of the session queue. Enterprise-only (GET /v3/enterprise/queue). Surfaces queueing pressure for capacity planning.

name: Role (API resource)
description: RBAC role aggregating permissions. Endpoint: GET /v3/enterprise/roles. Roles are assigned to users + service users.

name: Hypervisor (API resource)
description: Infrastructure-layer surface. Enterprise-only. GET /v3/enterprise/hypervisors. Surfaces hypervisor-level state for the customer's deployment.

name: IP access list (API resource)
description: Enterprise IP allowlist. Endpoints: GET / replace / clear. Restricts which IPs can access the customer's enterprise.

name: Session insights
description: AI-generated summary/analysis of session behavior. Generated on-demand via POST endpoint; retrievable via GET. Used for after-the-fact retrospective on agent runs.

name: Repository indexing status (API)
description: Status of code-search index build for a repository. v2 endpoint: GET /v2/repositories/<repo>/status. Bulk index endpoint: POST /v2/repositories/bulk-index.

name: Snapshot (API resource — enterprise)
description: Enterprise-deployment-level snapshot detail. v2 endpoint: GET /v2/snapshots/<id>. Surfaces details about a specific environment snapshot.

name: Repository clone (API)
description: Programmatic clone of a repository into a Devin organization. v2 endpoint: POST /v2/organizations/<org>/clone-repository.

name: Organization group limits
description: Per-org limits configurable by enterprise admins. Endpoints: GET / Update. Includes ACU caps and similar quotas.

name: Git connection (API resource)
description: Per-org connection to a Git provider. Endpoint: GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/git-providers/connections.

name: Git permission (API resource)
description: Per-repo Git access permission. Endpoints: GET / Create / Replace / Delete / Clear under /v3/organizations/{org_id}/git-providers/permissions.

name: 401 Unauthorized
description: Missing/invalid Authorization header, expired/invalid API key, malformed Bearer token, or using a legacy `apk_` key with the Devin MCP server (which only accepts `cog_`). Solution: verify Authorization header.

name: 403 Forbidden
description: Service user lacks required permission, wrong key type for endpoint (legacy key with v3), or attempting to access resources outside scope. v2 endpoints require Enterprise Admin role.

name: 404 Not Found
description: Incorrect endpoint URL OR resource doesn't exist OR caller doesn't have access (returns 404 instead of 403 to prevent existence leakage).

name: 429 Too Many Requests
description: Rate limit exceeded. Wait + retry with backoff. Apply at the per-key or per-org level depending on endpoint.

name: Principal types in /self response
description: GET /v3/self response field `principal_type` distinguishes 'service_user' from 'user'. For service users, populates service_user_id, service_user_name, org_id (or null for enterprise-scoped service users that span orgs).
